title: Paid Antonym - Part (ii) (SSC CGL 2020)

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Comfort
questions.solution:
B) Comfort(noun) – A state of physical ease and freedom from pain or constraint, solace, consolation. सुविधा; दिलासा देना
Antonym:Discontentment(noun) – Dissatisfaction, unhappiness, displeasure. असंतोष

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Conceited
questions.solution:
A) Conceited(adjective) – Having an excessively favorable opinion of oneself, vain, self-loving, egotistic. अभिमानी
Antonym:Modest(adjective) – Having or showing a moderate estimation of one's merits, unpretentious, humble. विनम्र

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Fallacy
questions.solution:
D) Fallacy(noun) – A mistaken belief, especially one based on unsound argument, misconception, delusion. भ्रांति
Antonym:Truth(noun) – That which is true or in accordance with fact or reality, fact, reality, actuality. सत्य

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Hassled
questions.solution:
C) Hassled(adjective) – Troubled, bothered, disturbed, harassed. परेशान
Antonym:Relaxed(adjective) – Free from tension and anxiety, calm, at ease, unworried. आराम से

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Anxiety
questions.solution:
C) Anxiety(noun) – A feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome. चिंता
Antonym:Certainty(noun) – A firm conviction that something is the case; sureness or confidence in something. निश्चितता

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Blemish
questions.solution:
C) Blemish(noun) – A mark or flaw that spoils the appearance of something, especially on a person's body. दाग
Antonym:Perfection(noun) – The condition, state, or quality of being free from all flaws or defects. निर्दोषता/पूर्णता

questions.question:

questions.question:

Triumph
questions.solution:
A) Triumph(noun) – Victory, conquest, success, achievement. विजय
Antonym:Failure(noun) – Lack of success, defeat, collapse, downfall. असफलता

questions.question:

questions.question:

Sabotage.

questions.question:

questions.solution:

questions.question:
